tools.name: search_soundcloud
tools.description: Free-text search of SoundCloud tracks, playlists or albums (e.g. 'melodic techno 2026'). Each result carries BPM and key; prefer values with bpmSource/keySource 'analyzed' (measured from audio) over 'uploader' (tags, often wrong). For a known artist + title, use resolve_track instead.

tools.name: resolve_track
tools.description: Find the best SoundCloud URL for a known artist + title (e.g. a line from a tracklist). Returns the best match and up to 3 alternates, each with a confidence score in [0, 1]; match is null when nothing fits.

tools.name: analyze_track
tools.description: Measure BPM and musical key (with Camelot code) from the audio of a SoundCloud track, using a 30-second window starting at `position` ms. BPM is corrected for half/double-time errors using the track's genre. First call takes ~5–15 s; repeat calls are cached for 30 days. Limited to 6 calls per minute

tools.name: get_playlist
tools.description: List the tracks of a SoundCloud playlist or album URL.
